hero_quoteText: I don't forget my mistakes, I use them to my advantage.
aboutMe_label: I’m Artem Lira, a frontend developer with hands-on experience building and improving websites and web interfaces.
aboutMe_text1: My work spans custom WordPress themes and content experiences, Shopify storefronts, and React interfaces. I turn designs and requirements into responsive, maintainable features that work across devices.
aboutMe_text2: I pay attention to the details behind a polished experience: accessibility, performance, technical SEO, reusable code, and clear content structures. I also enjoy learning new tools and contributing to modern React and Next.js projects.
aboutMe_text3: This portfolio brings together selected professional and personal projects. Each one offers a closer look at the problem, the implementation, and the technologies involved.
about_label: Hello, my name is Artem Lira!
about_aboutMe: I’m a frontend developer based in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine. I build responsive web experiences and work across WordPress, Shopify, React and Next.js.
about_text: Since beginning my web development journey in 2021, I’ve contributed to company and personal projects. I enjoy collaborating with a team, learning from each project, and making interfaces simpler, faster and easier to use.

privacy_intro: This portfolio is operated by Artem Lira. This page explains how information is handled when you visit the site, send a message, or request a meeting.
privacy_data_text: The contact form sends your name, email address, subject, and message so Artem can reply. The booking form sends your name, email address, selected meeting time and time zone, and any optional note so the meeting can be arranged and managed.
privacy_booking_text: Booking details are stored in the portfolio booking database and used to manage the appointment, send booking-related emails, and respond to you. The contact form message is delivered by email. Please do not include sensitive personal information in either form.
privacy_calendar_text: The booking feature checks calendar availability and creates or removes meeting events through the Google Calendar API. The integration is authorized by the portfolio owner’s Google account. Its Google authorization includes permission to view and edit calendar events, as well as check free/busy availability. A booking creates a generic meeting event; the visitor’s name, email, and optional note are not added to the calendar event. Google processes data under its own privacy terms.
privacy_analytics_text: This site uses Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity to understand visits and improve the portfolio. These tools may process technical and usage information such as pages viewed, interactions, device and browser details, and online identifiers or cookies, subject to their own settings and policies. Do not enter personal information into analytics fields or page URLs.
privacy_antispam_text: The contact and booking forms include a hidden honeypot field as a simple CAPTCHA-like anti-spam check. If an automated submission fills that field, the server discards or rejects the submission. This check is operated by this site and does not send information to a third-party CAPTCHA provider. The site does not currently use Google reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha.
privacy_retention_text: Information is kept only as needed to handle a message or booking and for related operational or legal needs. There is no fixed retention period; you can contact Artem to request access to, correction of, or deletion of information you submitted, subject to applicable requirements.
privacy_rights_text: You can choose not to submit a form. You can also manage cookies through your browser settings; disabling them may affect analytics or parts of the site. Google and Microsoft provide their own information and controls for data processed by their services.
privacy_contact_text: For privacy questions or requests about information submitted through this portfolio, contact Artem using the details on the contact page.
